The test image shows two tomato stems pulled from soil with roots attached, split open longitudinally to reveal brown discoloration in the pith/vascular tissue. The roots are fibrous and brown. This is stem/root tissue showing internal vascular browning.

From the part index, stem/root candidates are: Southern_Bacterial_Wilt, Southern_Blight, Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers, Bacterial_Wilt, Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot, Gray_Mold, Phytophthora_Blight, Rhizopus_Soft_Rots.

Top candidates based on symptoms:
- **Southern_Bacterial_Wilt** (pith discoloration, brown interior)
- **Verticillium_Wilt** (vascular discoloration)
- **Bacterial_Wilt** (vascular discoloration)
- **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot** (stem rot)

Now viewing one reference from each of 4 different classes:
Strong match - Southern_Bacterial_Wilt reference shows a split stem with brown/tan pith discoloration throughout, green exterior — very similar to the test image. Now checking 3 more classes:

The reference image 5473711 and test image 5473712 are consecutive Bugwood IDs — clearly companion images showing the same plants. The root reference shows the external view; the test image shows the same plants' stems split open revealing brown pith discoloration. Now I need one more class to meet the 4-class requirement:

Verticillium_Wilt shows V-shaped leaf lesions — completely different from the test image.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image (Bugwood 5473712) and Southern_Bacterial_Wilt root reference (Bugwood 5473711) are consecutive IDs, showing the same plants — external view vs. split-open view
- Both show same white background, same fibrous root system, same stem base
- Split stems reveal brown pith/vascular discoloration, matching the KB description: "interior stem shows dark or light brown discoloration in the pith area"
- The Southern_Bacterial_Wilt stem reference also confirms the identical split-stem presentation
- No white mycelium, no sclerotia, no concentric canker rings — ruling out Southern_Blight, Sclerotinia, Alternaria
- Bacterial_Wilt reference showed the water streaming test, different presentation
